title: ttheme marketplace
description:
The ttheme-marketplace.toml at the root of a ttheme marketplace: a repository or folder whose palettes/*.toml are the marketplace's palettes and whose works/*.toml propose works and characters the commons does not hold yet
https://ttheme.dev/docs/creating-palettes/publish

palette.description: A palette's name within the marketplace, its file name under palettes/ without .toml

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editor completion and checks; ttheme ignores it

name.description:
The marketplace's name: its palettes are <owner>@<name>/<palette>, where the owner is the repository's owner on GitHub. The built-in marketplace alone is named ttheme, and its palettes ttheme/<palette>
https://ttheme.dev/docs/creating-palettes/publish

description.description: What the marketplace holds, shown in Browse, ttheme marketplace and the marketplace page

name.description: The owner's GitHub handle, which names a marketplace read from a folder; a marketplace added from GitHub takes its repository's owner instead

email.description: An address for questions about the marketplace

url.description: The owner's page, such as a GitHub profile

renames.description:
Palettes that were renamed or removed: an old name maps to its new name, or to false once it is gone. Installs of the old name follow the chain on the next update, so keep the entries after everyone has moved
https://ttheme.dev/docs/creating-palettes/publish

force_remove_deleted_palettes.description: Whether a palette that leaves the marketplace without a rename is removed from the machines that installed it; by default they keep their copy

metadata.description: Anything else the owner wants to keep here; ttheme does not read it

fallback.description: The built-in marketplace's own key: its palette that stays out of every list and the new-tab rotation, still used by name. Any other marketplace leaves it out
